scientific_integrity: The original derangement wedge theorem and symmetric-group module computations are credited; only the ordinary alternating-label quotient homotopy classification is proposed as new.
scientific_limitations: Covers full injective-word regular CW complexes and alternating relabeling only; finite software check n=3..9 does not replace uniform proof. Priority relative to unindexed literature remains provisional.
title: Alternating-label quotients of injective-word complexes are Moore spaces
